name: @workspace/alloy-vector-worker
description: Alloy Embedding Fabric — vector embedding worker. Runs dense (and optional sparse) embedding on CPU using LocalCpuBackend. Supports micro-batching keyed by (profile, backend, modelRef, inputType) with size+time flush, queue-depth metrics, oversize rejection, and backpressure. Adapter seams for ExternalHttpBackend, FutureGpuBackend, FutureAzureBackend.
